body:
ARENA_HERO_TREE now auto-attacks nearby ARENA_OBSTACLE_TREE jungle decoration within ARENA_ATTACK_RANGE, healing itself per hit; trees are a permanent regenerating resource, never destroyed. Strike routes through a real compiled PARENA mod (stdlib/redgarden/tree_passive_mod.prn -> on_tree_passive_strike -> redgarden_host_tree_passive_strike), matching bloodflower_mod.prn's established split. Wire-synced (protocol.h ArenaSnapshotMsg.obstacle_hp) so real networked matches show it; client plays a local squish/jiggle hit-reaction on the tree canopy (same decaying-cosine bounce as hero squish) the instant a snapshot shows hp decrease. 6 new tests, live round-trip through the real compiled mod. Full 10-binary suite green. REDGARDEN c0e3ee6, PARENA 36920c1.

⚓ ☃
title: Tree hero passive -- auto-attacks nearby jungle trees for self-heal, PARENA mod
